label: Figure 15.7: A shift in the LRAS curve
alt: Two panels. (a) Keynesian: the whole hockey-stick AS curve shifts right from AS1 to AS2. (b) New classical: the vertical LRAS line shifts right from LRAS1 to LRAS2.
caption: An increase in the economy’s productive potential shifts LRAS right. (a) In the Keynesian model the whole three-phase AS curve moves right from AS<sub>1</sub> to AS<sub>2</sub>, so full-employment output is higher. (b) In the new classical model the vertical LRAS line moves right from LRAS<sub>1</sub> to LRAS<sub>2</sub>.
